en.t: Maybe he had gone mad himself ...

units.source_text: 在女人激动的态度前，他有些退缩了，倒是男人的内部，扭曲的空白不断扩散开去……

en.t: Faced with the woman's agitated manner, he shrank back a little, while inside the man a twisted emptiness kept spreading outward ...

units.source_text: 被人欺负到这种地步，体面还能起什么作用？……

en.t: When someone had been pushed around to this extent, what use could dignity still have? ...

units.source_text: 如果说展览的一方难为情，那么，参观的一方也同样该难为情……

en.t: If the side being put on display felt ashamed, then the side doing the viewing ought to feel just as ashamed ...

units.source_text: 没有必要把“示众的”和“看客”分得那么清楚……

en.t: There was no need to draw such a clear line between the one on display and the spectators ...

units.source_text: 即使多少有些不同，但把它想象成为了自己的消失而举行的一个小小仪式，也就未尝不可了嘛……

en.t: Even if it was somewhat different, it would not be so bad to imagine it as a small ceremony held for his own disappearance ...

units.source_text: 而且，再想想作为代价换来的东西吧……

en.t: Besides, think again about what he would receive in exchange ...

units.source_text: 可以自由自在地在地面上走动！……

en.t: He would be able to walk freely on the surface of the ground! ...

units.source_text: 真渴望把脸伸出这腐臭的水面，深深吸一口空气！

en.t: How he longed to thrust his face out of this stinking water and draw a deep breath of air!
